title: A Unified XAI-NSAI Analytical Framework for Trustworthy IoT Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.41424v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The widespread deployment of Internet of Things (IoT) devices in critical environments makes anomaly detection essential for identifying abnormal behaviors and supporting timely investigation and response. However, accurate detection alone is insufficient. Practical IoT deployments must also provide explanations, incorporate domain knowledge and reasoning, operate under IoT constraints, and support human decision making. Although recently proposed approaches increasingly incorporate Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) or Neuro-Symbolic Artificial Intelligence (NSAI), XAI and NSAI methods are often considered independently. We argue that they should be considered together to better understand their complementary roles in supporting trustworthy IoT anomaly detection. translated_title: 面向可信物联网异常检测的统一XAI-NSAI分析框架
translated_abstract: 物联网（IoT）设备在关键环境中的广泛部署，使得异常检测对于识别异常行为、支持及时的调查与响应变得至关重要。然而，仅有准确的检测是不够的。实际的物联网部署还必须能够提供解释、融合领域知识与推理、在物联网约束条件下运行，并支持人类决策。尽管近来提出的方法越来越多地结合了可解释人工智能（XAI）或神经符号人工智能（NSAI），但XAI与NSAI方法通常被独立地加以考虑。我们认为，应当将两者结合起来考察，以更好地理解它们在支持可信物联网异常检测中的互补作用。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一个围绕五个互补维度组织的统一分析框架，该框架为刻画……提供了结构化的基础。
tldr: 该论文提出首个将可解释人工智能（XAI）与神经符号人工智能（NSAI）统一结合、围绕五个互补维度构建的分析框架，为构建可信的物联网异常检测系统提供了结构化分析基础。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified analytical framework organized around five complementary dimensions that jointly considers XAI and NSAI, providing a structured basis for trustworthy IoT anomaly detection.
